mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion (potassium, magnesium) which increases anticholinergic side effects and arrhythmia risk; benztropine's anticholinergic effects may impair fluid balance awareness and reduce diuretic efficacy.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, ensure adequate potassium intake, assess for anticholinergic toxicity, and consider alternative antiparkinson agent if possible.
